selection: Consecutive original pivots in the existing nonzero alternating movement domain. Exclude exact previously evaluated six-point coordinate sequences. Split remaining eligible chronological indices into cap equal-count bins and select each bin's middle index. Never select on outcomes. Four-point evaluate-as scopes test SINGLE_ZIGZAG and FLAT cardinality only.
budget_expiry: Record every not-executed planned scope; no partial search claimed exhaustive.
cache: Exact geometry/config/snapshot cache only. Reuse prior deterministic discovery recipe for matching windows; fresh subjects and bindings for each evaluation. No cross-context result cache.
link_selection: M1/M2 role 5 to every new Daily NI scope. Every new Daily NI role to new intraday NI scopes whose bar-label dates overlap that role's calendar range; date routing is not ancestry. If over cap, equal-count-bin midpoints selected over chronological planned triples; retain all unvisited triples. Exact public observational link factory decides support. No outcome filtering. Intraday-to-intraday parent envelope unsupported by existing contract, so no invented deeper edge.
open_tail: All saved bars after each selected last endpoint remain separately displayed, never forced into a six-point structure. Existing developing flags retained; no completion inferred.
